title.narrative: Support for the creation of an integrated automatic radiation monitoring system covering the whole territory of Ukraine

description.narrative:
¿     Identification of the existing radiation monitoring systems, incl. automated ones;

¿      Establishment of a performance gap given the existing radiation risks, including the trans-border ones, based on best international practice, to include the identification of currently installed but outdated and/or obsolete equipment; 

¿      Establishment of a design (including the basic design documentation) for a national Integrated Automated Radiation Monitoring System (IARMS) based on best international practice;

¿      Development of system information exchange procedures and formats with account taken of the exchange protocols of the existing systems and international standards, such as IRIX;

¿      Development of technical specifications for the supply, installation, and commissioning of the required systems, together with detailed cost estimations for procurement; drafting of the tender documents;

¿      Support to the Scientific and Technology Centre Ukraine (STCU) for the tender procedures for EU-financed system equipment supply, installation and commissioning.
